author: Polar_Express
body:
Hi,

Here is my newest walls map. I call it "playgound" it is about 40% smaller than the normal walls map, but has some cool features that I hope you all will like. I have it on my realms server if you would like to see it live. - just for inspection, cant play it tho.

It has a unique mine, and is built for fast easy game-play. The timer is set at 8:00min not 10:00min. The map should be simple to learn and should have a good play flow. The items are not over powered, and have been selected carefully so that players do not end up with an inventory full of items or junk items that are not going to be used. 

This is a clay hybrid map and has many flat areas by design. The map is built at a height of 150 so folks that like to tower to build height will be more manageable. Also, the map has a ledge that goes around the outside of all the quads, so you can run around the map if ya like on the boarder.

Thanks for having a look. if you want to see it live just post here. I know some people may not like how "flat" the fighting area is from the pics, but once you see it you will understand - the scale is not the same as other maps.

Map Images: http://imgur.com/a/0LCq3
Map Download with YML: https://www.dropbox.com/s/9riogfk3aahfxjm/playground.zip?dl=0
Just YML: https://www.dropbox.com/s/wfnp8718jcol9cc/map.yml?dl=0

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Cezbla : thanks for your thoughts, not sure I understand what you mean about world edit on each side? ( FYI  I don't use Worldedit )

:As for size , its bigger than you think, but still on the small side, but it is in no way cramped or a size that would hurt game play - unless your game play is  " Dig 50 levels to the bedrock, and hide" if that's your game, this is not the map for you.

:Avicus has to have unique content  with play tweaks, this will keep us relevant, we cant just say " if its different " the play style will be bad, we cant just not give something a fair shot because our opinion says so..

The map is small: but we have so many large maps on walls, I know you don't play walls on Avicus often, but as a map maker I hate to see new players that walk around after a match has started with only a stone sword... and it is happening a lot. This map is smaller, easier to navigate, and breaks up the long matches. It flows  pretty good from what me and another developer saw when we were looking at it on my realm, but again. It's really hard to tell from the pics. I didn't do as much detail work, as I wanted a good chest mix, good play flow, and a map that you still had to mine, still had to get chests, but didn't have to spend forever getting prepared. Once the match starts, no one is going to be in full diamond with 100 potions. It's an easy mode map, that requires some prep ( better than the old jungle or walls), that's it. So unlike some of the large more detailed maps like Blue Cove or Knights Tower  that most people will never figure out, this one is fast and fair. If you want to see it let me know and Ill let you join the realm to view it. Thanks again.
